questions.question: Which institution is collaborating with ICMR on a project to develop a blood test for early detection of triple-negative breast cancer?
options: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)
Gandhi Institute of Technology and Management (GITAM)
Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER)
questions.explanation: The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) is funding a project at GITAM University to develop a blood test for the early detection of triple-negative breast cancer. This project involves comparing blood samples from early-stage patients with those from healthy women.
questions.background: Triple-negative breast cancer is a particularly aggressive form of breast cancer that does not have receptors for estrogen, progesterone, or HER2, making it difficult to treat with targeted therapies. Early detection is crucial for improving treatment outcomes.
questions.examRelevance: ICMR-funded GITAM project aims to develop a blood test for early detection of triple-negative breast cancer.

source.title: ICMR-funded GITAM project aims at blood test for early detection of triple-negative breast cancer
